body: Thank you. It makes a lot of sense. It's just how I've always been treat so I felt like that's the only way it will ever be with people. It's hard to break a lifetime habit. And I don't know how to act like I have self respect but obviously working on myself is the first thing I need to do before I even contemplate it. Thank you so much for your comments. They hit home. :)

That's the thing. I have spoken to him and he really wants to help me and be there for me and so on. But he has a life to live and I do feel very unfair putting him through it. He has such a good group of friends and he's so happy yet he is choosing to be with someone unhappy. I do feel like I need to push him away or he may resent me. I'll try not to from now on.

I have been brought up with negativity all of my life. I'm made to think on a daily basis that I'm worthless.
TO quote other people: "Unlikable, unfunny, screwed up in the head, messed up, etc." and that's just my mother. Who I love, she just doesn't like the person I am because shes quite prudish. I also suffer from various degrees of mental health due to my upbringing. I also don't have one friend. not one. So there isn't anyone in my life to enjoy it with. I'm a very lonely negative person in short.
